facts.value: C1 live on Pi; 120 Python tests passed there. Justin confirmed raised-wheel forward and left pivot directions, a loaded forward crawl, and a loaded right pivot followed by forward motion without contact. Later bounded trials showed repeated stop-turn-go; a gentle moving curve was added for clearer paths. Every trial ended with ESP32 stopped and zero wheel outputs. Python source is installed, private roaming profile remains uncommissioned, and new ESP32 phone firmware is unflashed. Continuous room and outdoor runs remain unverified. Last confirmed motor power was ON during a floor trial, with switch-off unconfirmed.

facts.value: 2026-11-14 verified laptop bench test: CP2102 on COM3; C1 identity responds at 460800 8N1 (model 0x41, firmware 1.02). Health status/error both zero before and after a bounded three-second scan. Received 4584 valid nodes, including 4153 positive nonzero-quality ranges at 138.5–3376 mm. STOP sent, subsequent idle stream zero bytes, port closed. Short live ranging passes; sustained power, calibrated accuracy, scan-rate stability, physical standstill and Pi/ROS integration remain unverified. Supersedes earlier unknown communication/function; no robot drive commanded. Evidence: updates/2026-11-14-c1-laptop-bench-test.md.
facts.status: Actual Windows serial bench test; limited three-second live ranging, no calibrated or sustained validation
